entities.name: Gabrán mac Domangairt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gabrán mac Domangairt or Gabrán the Traitor was king of Dál Riata in the mid-6th century. He is the eponymous ancestor of the Cenél nGabráin. Gabrán was the son of Domangart Réti and the father of Áedán mac Gabráin.
